1 Executive Summary

CSDM 5.0 Explorer is a ServiceNow scoped application that provides real-time CMDB health assessment against the ServiceNow Common Service Data Model (CSDM) 5.0 standard. It evaluates CMDB adherence across 7 weighted dimensions , computes an overall compliance score (0–100), persists historical scan results, and exposes the data through a REST API consumed by a 3D visualization frontend .

The application enables CMDB teams to answer: "How well does our CMDB conform to CSDM 5.0, and where are the gaps?"

Key Capabilities:
  • 7-dimension CSDM adherence scoring with configurable relationship rules
  • 3-component Service Model Depth analysis (Population + Relationship Coverage + Chain Depth)
  • 4-sub-metric Relationship Compliance scoring (Type Correctness + Class-Pair Match + Coverage + Integrity)
  • Configuration-driven rule management — no code changes needed to add/modify rules
  • Automatic scan result persistence with full JSON breakdown
  • REST API for integration with 3D Explorer UI and external consumers

5.2 Scoring Formula

Overall Score = (D1 × 0.15) + (D2 × 0.20) + (D3 × 0.20) + (D4 × 0.15) + (D5 × 0.10) + (D6 × 0.10) + (D7 × 0.10)
# Dimension Weight Method
1 Domain Coverage 15% calculateDomainCoverage()
2 Data Completeness 20% calculateDataCompleteness()
3 Service Model Depth 20% calculateServiceModelDepth()
4 Relationship Compliance 15% calculateRelationshipCompliance()
5 Lifecycle Governance 10% calculateLifecycleGovernance()
6 Data Hygiene 10% calculateDataHygiene()
7 Customization Risk 10% calculateCustomizationRisk()

6 Dimension Calculations — Detailed Logic

6.1 Domain Coverage (15%)

Purpose: Measures whether all 5 CSDM domain layers contain data.

Domain Tables Checked (24 total)
Foundation cmdb_ci_server , cmdb_ci_computer , cmdb_ci_vm_instance , cmdb_ci_network_gear , cmdb_ci_storage_device , cmdb_ci_database_instance , cmn_location , core_company , cmn_department
Design – App Portfolio cmdb_ci_business_app , cmdb_ci_appl , cmdb_software_instance , cmdb_ci_spkg
Manage Technical cmdb_ci_service_technical , cmdb_ci_service_auto , cmdb_ci_service_discovered , cmdb_ci_endpoint
Manage Business cmdb_ci_service , service_offering
Sell/Consume sc_cat_item , sc_request , incident , change_request
score = (populatedTables / totalTables) × 100

6.2 Data Completeness (20%)

Purpose: Measures critical field fill-rates on 3 key CMDB tables.

Table Critical Fields
cmdb_ci_server name , ip_address , os , serial_number , ram , cpu_count , manufacturer
cmdb_ci_appl name , version , install_status , owned_by , managed_by , used_for
cmdb_ci_service name , owned_by , managed_by , service_classification , used_for , busines_criticality
score = average(completeness per table) where completeness = (completeRecords / totalRecords) × 100

6.3 Service Model Depth (20%) — 3-Component Composite

Service Model Depth = (Population × 0.30) + (Relationship Coverage × 0.50) + (Chain Depth × 0.20)

A. Population (30%)

Order Level Table
1 Business Service cmdb_ci_service
2 Service Offering service_offering
3 Technical Service cmdb_ci_service_technical
4 Application Service cmdb_ci_service_auto
5 Application cmdb_ci_appl
6 Infrastructure cmdb_ci_server
score = (populatedLevels / 6) × 100

B. Relationship Coverage (50%)

For each rule marked service_model_relevant=true :

coverage = distinctParentsWithRelationship / totalParentCIs
score = average(coverage per rule) × 100

C. Chain Depth (20%)

Business Service ↓ (Depends on::Used by) Application Service ↓ (Depends on::Used by) Application ↓ (Runs on::Runs) Infrastructure
score = (connectedLinks / totalPossibleLinks) × 100

6.4 Relationship Compliance (15%) — 4-Sub-Metric Composite

Score = (Type Correctness × 0.40) + (Class-Pair Match × 0.30) + (Coverage × 0.20) + (Integrity × 0.10)
Sub-Metric Weight Measures
Type Correctness 40% Rels between expected pairs using CSDM-expected type
Class-Pair Match 30% In-scope rels connecting expected class pairs
Coverage 20% Avg % of parent CIs with expected relationships
Integrity 10% Rels free of retired/orphaned CI references

6.5 Lifecycle Governance (10%)

Tables: cmdb_ci_server , cmdb_ci_appl , cmdb_ci_service , cmdb_ci_service_technical

Checks: life_cycle_stage OR life_cycle_stage_status non-empty.

score = (CIsWithLifecycle / totalCriticalCIs) × 100

6.6 Data Hygiene (10%)

Check Logic
Stale CIs sys_updated_on < (now − 180 days)
Orphaned CIs Not in cmdb_rel_ci as parent or child
score = max(0, 100 − (stale/total × 50) − (orphaned/total × 50))

6.7 Customization Risk (10%)

Risk Type Source Severity Penalty
Custom fields sys_dictionary ( u_* ) Medium −5 each
Custom BRs sys_script (non-global, active) High −10 each
score = max(0, 100 − (high×10 + medium×5 + low×2))

7 REST API

Property Value
Base URI /api/x_147805_csdmviz/csdm_explorer
Service ID csdm_explorer
Consumes/Produces application/json

7.1 GET /overview

(function(request, response) {
    try {
        var calculator = new x_147805_csdmviz.CSDMScoreCalculator();
        var result = calculator.runFullScan();
        response.setStatus(200);
        response.setBody(result);
    } catch(ex) {
        response.setStatus(500);
        response.setBody(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Scan failed: ' + ex.message, score: 0 }));
    }
})(request, response);

User clicks "Scan Now" │ ▼ GET /api/x_147805_csdmviz/csdm_explorer/overview │ ▼ new CSDMScoreCalculator().runFullScan() │ ├──► _getActiveRelationshipRules() → load 14 rules (cached) │ ├──► calculateDomainCoverage() → GlideAggregate × 24 tables ├──► calculateDataCompleteness() → GlideAggregate + GlideRecord × 3 tables ├──► calculateServiceModelDepth() → 3 sub-components │ ├── _calculateServiceModelPopulation() (30%) │ ├── _calculateServiceModelRelationships() (50%) │ └── _calculateServiceModelChainDepth() (20%) ├──► calculateRelationshipCompliance() → per-rule queries + integrity ├──► calculateLifecycleGovernance() → lifecycle field checks × 4 tables ├──► calculateDataHygiene() → stale + orphan detection └──► calculateCustomizationRisk() → sys_dictionary + sys_script │ ▼ Compute weighted overall score │ ▼ _saveScanResult() → INSERT into x_147805_csdmviz_scan_result │ ▼ Return full JSON → 200 OK → UI renders 3D visualization

11 Caching & Performance

Mechanism Scope What Purpose
this._cachedRules Per-scan Relationship rules Avoids re-querying config table
GlideAggregate Per-query Record counts Database-side aggregation
Bounded traversal Per-scan Chain depth Stops at first broken link

Estimated queries per scan: ~80–120

Pattern Implementation
Table validation _validateTable() → GlideRecord.isValid()
Invalid config Skips bad rule, continues scan
Query failures try/catch + gs.warn() , returns 0
Scan failure REST API returns 500 with error
Save failure gs.error() , returns null

14 Configuration & Administration

Adding a New Relationship Rule

  1. Navigate to CSDM 5.0 Explorer → Relationship Rules
  2. Click New
  3. Fill in Parent Class, Relationship Type (Forward::Reverse), Child Class
  4. Set Service Model Relevant = true if needed for depth scoring
  5. Set Active = true
  6. Save — next scan uses it automatically
No code change required. Both Relationship Compliance and Service Model Depth recognize new rules immediately.
